name: REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
description_en: The upstream CLI and MCP server for evidence-based investigations of shipped software and runtime behavior.
description_zh: REA 官方 CLI 与 MCP 服务，连接分析工具并保留调查证据及限制。
requirements: rea-agents 6.5.0 was the published npm version at review time.
Node.js ^22.19.0 || ^24.11.0 || >=26.0.0; additional tools depend on the target.

name: Official reverse-engineer-anything skill
description_en: Target routing, connection recovery and evidence practices for agents using REA.
description_zh: 官方面向使用者的调查技能，包含目标路由、连接恢复与证据工作流。
requirements: Installing the skill provides instructions; it does not by itself register MCP or install analysis engines.
Use the connected server's actual tool schemas; repository main may be ahead of an installed release.

name: Installation and client setup
description_en: Reviewed setup plans, client registration, provider prerequisites and scoped readiness checks.
description_zh: 安装、客户端配置、分析引擎依赖及按任务检查就绪状态的官方入口。
requirements: Supported Node.js and npm.
Setup previews client configuration changes; native engines have separate prerequisites.

name: CLI and Evidence
description_en: CLI workflows for saving Evidence and projecting smaller views from completed analysis.
description_zh: 保存完整 Evidence，再提取摘要或模块视图，适合脚本与可复现记录。
requirements: Installed REA CLI or an explicitly pinned package runner.
CLI processes are separate; retain result files for later operations.

name: MCP contracts and generated catalog
description_en: Canonical tool contracts, provider discovery and Evidence semantics for integration authors.
description_zh: 官方工具协议、能力发现和 Evidence 语义；适合集成与核对实际工具边界。
requirements: A compatible MCP client for live use.
Discover the live catalog before relying on tools documented on main.

name: Native binary investigation
description_en: Locate a function, inspect instructions and pseudocode, and follow references with a selected native provider.
description_zh: 从函数清单到指令、伪代码和引用链的原生二进制调查流程。
requirements: A target binary and a configured supported provider such as Ghidra, Hopper or IDA.
Host, architecture and provider support are scoped separately; pseudocode is not original source.

name: Cross-layer JavaScript application workflows
description_en: Trace features and compare authenticated JavaScript application graphs while preserving static-analysis limits.
description_zh: 从 JavaScript 应用图追踪功能、比较版本，同时保留静态分析的不确定性。
requirements: Evidence from analyze_javascript_application or supported runtime reconciliation.
No native engine is required for the static JavaScript path; keep the complete parent Evidence.

name: Static Android APK analysis
description_en: Inspect Android package identity, classes, methods and references through REA's JADX integration.
description_zh: 经 REA 的 JADX 集成检查 APK、类、方法与引用；结果不等于运行时验证。
requirements: Full JDK 17 or newer and caller-supplied jadx-headless-mcp 0.7.1 with the documented digest check.
Linux requires a procps-compatible ps for provider process ownership.

name: Managed-code analysis
description_en: Read PE/CLI metadata and CIL, compare managed members and inspect declared native boundaries without loading the assembly.
description_zh: 静态读取 .NET 元数据与 CIL，比较成员并检查声明的原生代码边界。
requirements: A supported PE/CLI assembly; no native engine is required for metadata/CIL inspection.
NativeAOT, IL2CPP and packaged single-file deployments have different boundaries.

name: Historical web network captures
description_en: Inspect saved web captures offline; recorded URLs are not fetched and no proxy is started.
description_zh: 离线检查已有 HAR、SAZ 等网页流量记录；不会自动抓包或访问记录中的 URL。
requirements: A supported existing capture and an explicit format selection.
PCAP/TShark workflows are separate and have different host/tool requirements.

name: Firmware analysis
description_en: Inspect firmware regions with Binwalk and explicitly extract with Unblob, retaining tool and artifact identity.
description_zh: 用 Binwalk 检查固件区域、用 Unblob 显式提取，并记录工具与制品身份。
requirements: Caller-supplied Binwalk 3.1.x for inspection; Unblob 26.6.x for extraction.
The documented verification scope is Linux x64; extraction needs a new caller-selected output directory.

name: Recorded packet capture inspection
description_en: Select TShark fields, display filters and decode-as rules over an existing network, USB or Bluetooth capture, and look up installed field names. It does not capture traffic, open an interface or control a device.
description_zh: 用 TShark 字段、显示过滤器和 decode-as 规则检查已有的网络、USB 或蓝牙抓包，并可查询已安装的字段名；不抓取流量、不打开网络接口，也不控制设备。
requirements: Caller-supplied TShark 4.x on Linux with util-linux prlimit; macOS and Windows hosts are refused before inspection. Listed in the rea-agents 6.5.0 release notes.

Dissector output describes the selected recording, not verified device behavior. Upstream fixtures are generated Ethernet/UDP/DNS and Bluetooth HCI PCAPs; PCAPNG, USB, BLE ATT and physical capture are not established by them.

name: Packet capture summaries
description_en: Summarize a saved pcap or pcapng file’s endpoints, DNS questions and addresses, TLS SNI, protocol stacks and HTTP URIs into paged Evidence views. It does not capture traffic or fetch recorded targets.
description_zh: 把已保存 pcap/pcapng 文件中的端点、DNS 查询与地址、TLS SNI、协议栈和 HTTP URI 汇总为可分页的 Evidence 视图；不抓取流量，也不访问记录中的目标。
requirements: Caller-supplied Wireshark 4.x tshark and capinfos. Capture inspection needs Linux with util-linux prlimit or Windows Job Objects; macOS reports a capability gap. Listed in the rea-agents 6.5.0 release notes.

Upstream’s current verification used Linux, Node 24.18.0 and Wireshark 4.0.17; actual Windows execution is unverified. Summaries do not establish decrypted payloads, process identity or the absence of unrecorded traffic.

name: Recorded signal decoding
description_en: Run caller-chosen sigrok protocol decoders, such as UART or I2C, over an existing logic-signal recording and keep annotation text with sample ranges. It does not acquire samples or communicate with hardware.
description_zh: 用调用方指定的 sigrok 协议解码器（如 UART、I2C）解码已有的逻辑信号记录，并保留带采样区间的注释文本；不采集样本，也不与硬件通信。
requirements: Caller-supplied sigrok-cli 0.7.2 with libsigrokdecode on Linux, plus util-linux prlimit; macOS and Windows are refused. Listed in the rea-agents 6.5.0 release notes.

The caller supplies decoder stacks, channel names and settings such as baud rate. Upstream’s fixture is a synthesized 9600-baud UART VCD; other formats, decoders and physical acquisition are not established.

name: Browser observation guide
description_en: Follow a user-triggered export request in the supplied Notes browser example and connect it to the downloaded result.
description_zh: 通过官方 Notes 示例关联用户点击、导出请求与下载结果；REA 负责观察。
requirements: A user-owned Chrome-family browser, loopback CDP connection and explicitly allowed origins.
The recorded upstream example used a separate controller to click; REA did not perform the click.

name: Aegis: trace a login-code calculation
description_en: An official APK investigation follows TOTP methods in Aegis and publishes artifact identities and selected Evidence.
description_zh: 追踪 Aegis APK 的 TOTP 计算，官方公开目标指纹与选取的调查证据。
requirements: Upstream case: Aegis 3.4.3, REA 6.1.0, jadx-headless-mcp 0.7.1 and OpenJDK 21 on Linux x64.
Use the matching official APK for reproduction; this listing did not rerun the case.

name: DownUnderCTF: masked-squares flag checker
description_en: An official educational challenge investigation connects binary checks to equations and records an original-program validation.
description_zh: 官方教育 CTF 案例：从检查函数得到方程，并记录原程序验证过程。
requirements: Upstream case: public DownUnderCTF 2023 challenge, REA 4.1.0 and Ghidra 12.1.4 on Linux x64.
Target hash and source revision are documented; author-reported execution was not repeated here.

name: DX-Ball: reconstruct sound panning
description_en: Recover one sound-pan function from instructions and constants; upstream cites 3,205 cases and a 63-byte match.
description_zh: 根据指令与常量重建单个声像函数；上游报告 3,205 例与 63 字节匹配。
requirements: The matching DX-Ball 1.07 executable and the documented native-analysis environment.
The cited reconstruction checks concern one function, not full-game equivalence; no checks were rerun here.

name: Notion: trace the clipboard bridge
description_en: Trace a packaged Electron clipboard path using REA findings and separate source inspection; the dynamic wrapper remains a stated limit.
description_zh: 结合 REA 发现与独立源码阅读追踪剪贴板桥；动态包装器仍有明确限制。
requirements: Upstream case uses Notion Desktop 7.6.1 packaged JavaScript and REA 4.1.0.
The full clipboard route was not automatically paired or observed as a desktop execution.

name: TH04: recover a DOS bullet-ring helper
description_en: Inspect a 16-bit PC-98 DOS helper and relate its angle calculation to a pinned reconstruction and historical compiler checks.
description_zh: 检查 PC-98 DOS 的 16 位弹幕角度辅助函数，并关联固定版本重建与历史编译器检查。
requirements: The matching original TH04 MAIN.EXE and the documented Ghidra DOS load profile.
The showcase covers one helper; full-game reconstruction claims are outside its scope.

name: JavaScript and Electron: follow a CSV export
description_en: A source-owned Notes fixture teaches the renderer, preload, IPC and CSV path with linked analysis evidence.
description_zh: 官方自建 Notes 样例，从 renderer、preload、IPC 到 CSV 导出建立证据链。
requirements: Supported Node.js and REA; no native engine is required for this static fixture.
The fixture is source-owned teaching material, not an installed Electron distribution; static findings do not prove execution.

name: rea-playbook
description_en: An Electron practice target, Evidence extractor and MCP probe; offline fixture mode is distinguished from real REA analysis.
description_zh: 提供 Electron 练习目标、Evidence 提取与 MCP 探测，区分离线展示和真正调用 REA。
requirements: README pins the real-analysis path to rea-agents 6.3.0 and lists supported Node.js versions.
The offline demo reads bundled results without running REA; its tests were not rerun here.

name: dsh-mcp-rea
description_en: A community MCP bridge presents a smaller selected tool surface and forwards explicit commands to the REA CLI.
description_zh: 社区 MCP 适配桥，以精选工具和 CLI 转发缩小宿主需要处理的工具面。
requirements: Requires REA and the relevant analysis providers; distributed as a local bundle rather than a public npm package.
Use the documented REA_ENTRY mode for direct execution; PATH fallback invokes a shell.
Its README's provider/platform claims may lag upstream; no installation or security audit was performed.

name: rea-jev
description_en: A Claude Code plugin adds Jev-based routing and evidence checks around a pinned REA MCP integration.
description_zh: Claude Code 社区插件，在固定版本 REA MCP 外增加 Jev 路由和证据检查。
requirements: Claude Code, supported Node.js and the plugin's documented macOS/Linux environment.
Optional Jev service credentials enable external model calls; excerpts may be sent to that service.
Hooks fail open on provider failure; they are not a security guarantee.

name: rea-lab
description_en: A Windows REA/Ghidra lab with seeded challenges, published studies, upstream contributions and recorded limitations.
description_zh: Windows REA/Ghidra 实验室，提供已知答案挑战、公开研究、上游贡献与限制说明。
requirements: The documented environment uses Windows 11, REA 6.4.0 and Ghidra 12.1.4.
Study results are author-reported and task/model-specific, not independently reproduced by this index.
Code and documentation use different licenses; inspect the relevant repository notices.

name: rea-casebook
description_en: A Claude Code mod collects received REA Evidence, tracks unknowns and records findings that cite delivered evidence IDs.
description_zh: Claude Code mod 汇集收到的 REA Evidence、追踪 unknown，并校验发现所引用的证据 ID。
requirements: README requires Claude Code 2.1.296 or newer and an MCP server registered under the name rea.
Developed with REA 6.4.0 and Ghidra 12.1 on Windows; broader behavior was not tested here.
Evidence IDs being present does not itself prove a conclusion is correct.

name: PicoPrint: LX-D02 printer investigation
description_en: The author describes REA-assisted Android investigation followed by separate Hermes decompilation to support a Windows BLE printer.
description_zh: 作者报告以 REA 开始 Android 调查，再借助独立 Hermes 工具实现 Windows BLE 打印。
requirements: Project README lists Windows 10/11, Bluetooth LE, an LX-D02 printer and Go 1.25+ to build.
REA's stated role was readiness/device discovery and investigation framing; hermes-dec handled Hermes v98.
Hardware behavior and author-reported results were not reproduced here.

name: Awesome Reverse Engineering
description_en: A task-oriented reverse-engineering resource list by REA's maintainer, useful for broader tools and foundations.
description_zh: REA 维护者整理的通用逆向资源目录，适合查找基础知识与相邻工具。
requirements: Individual tools retain their own requirements and licenses.
Inclusion in this companion list does not establish REA integration or compatibility.

name: Awesome REA Cases
description_en: A bilingual collection of REA and other AI-assisted reverse engineering cases, with source links and explicit distinctions between reported and reproduced outcomes.
description_zh: 中英双语的 REA 与其他 AI 辅助逆向案例合集，附来源并区分作者报告、进行中的工作和复现状态。
requirements: A discovery index; review each case's original source, redistribution rights, and evidence status before reproducing it.

name: ReaCut: video-editor reconstruction
description_en: An independent video editor whose authors document REA-assisted investigation of Jianying/CapCut behavior and project formats. The public implementation includes a local timeline, FFmpeg export and an experimental, lossy draft importer.
description_zh: 独立视频编辑器，作者公开了利用 REA 研究剪映／CapCut 行为与项目格式的过程。实现包含本地时间线、FFmpeg 导出，以及实验性的有损草稿导入。
requirements: The v0.5.0 preview reports macOS Apple Silicon testing; Windows/Linux builds still need device validation. The macOS package is ad-hoc signed and not notarized.
The experimental importer is documented against controlled Jianying 11.0.12922 drafts. Basic conversions are lossy: effects, keyframes and styles can be lost, and projects cannot be written back.
REA supports the reported research workflow but is not a runtime dependency. The project uses its own code and format; MIT source and bundled third-party components retain separate licenses.

name: awesome-rea (yibie): verification-focused projects and practice reports
description_en: Organizes AI-assisted game decompilation, native ports, static recompilation and tooling around stated acceptance checks, alongside a separate track of practitioner write-ups and discussions. Useful for finding primary reports and comparing how projects define correctness.
description_zh: 围绕明确的验收检查整理 AI 辅助游戏反编译、原生移植、静态重编译和工具，并另设实践文章与讨论分类。适合寻找一手报告，比较不同项目如何定义正确性。
requirements: Project entries describe acceptance mechanisms; the separate discussion track does not require public code or an acceptance test. Listing is not independent runtime verification.
The reviewed snapshot has an intentionally empty console/firmware category. Do not infer implemented firmware coverage from the planned category.
Collection summaries can lag primary repositories, including platform support, progress and license scope; follow the linked project sources before relying on a claim.
The collection LICENSE declares CC0 1.0 Universal. Linked projects and source articles retain their own rights and license conditions.
An independent community collection; entries are not necessarily REA integrations, and the list is not an official upstream affiliation.

name: Virtual Desktop Streamer: rehosting the platform layer on Linux
description_en: An author-reported Claude Code and REA workflow replaces the macOS streamer’s capture, encoding, audio and input layer with Linux implementations while reusing vendor protocol libraries. The documented result targets desktop streaming and video playback, not Windows-only VR game streaming.
description_zh: 作者报告通过 Claude Code 与 REA，将 macOS 串流端的捕获、编码、音频和输入层替换为 Linux 实现，同时复用厂商协议库。文档中的目标是桌面串流和视频播放，而非仅 Windows 串流端提供的 VR 游戏串流。
requirements: Requires the official macOS Virtual Desktop installer for proprietary libraries and the user’s Virtual Desktop headset application. It is not a complete protocol reimplementation or an official vendor port.

The build uses .NET 8. Linux runtime dependencies include GStreamer 1.16+, PulseAudio/PipeWire, X11 or an appropriate Wayland portal, OpenSSL 1.1 or 3 and uinput access; video-file playback additionally needs FFmpeg 7.

Published testing used a simulated headset, mock portal and container networking. No real headset, real Wi-Fi or GPU encoder was available; internet matchmaking and same-address network changes were untested.
The scroll fix was checked at device/libinput level without directly observing the receiving X11 app. This catalog did not repeat those tests or validate headset compatibility.
MIT applies to this repository’s code only. Vendor libraries remain proprietary; the project limits redistribution of packages containing them and does not grant rights to the headset application.

name: Open Claude UI: REA-informed interface reference components
description_en: Publishes React components, motion helpers and design-system notes derived from the author’s reported REA investigation of Claude Desktop. It is useful as an interface-reconstruction case, with version-specific observations rather than proof of a complete assistant application or backend clone.
description_zh: 发布 React 组件、动效辅助模块和设计系统笔记，作者将其归因于使用 REA 调查 Claude Desktop。它可作为界面重建案例；观察结果受版本约束，不能证明已完整复刻助手应用或后端。
requirements: Package 1.0.0 declares React/React DOM 18+, Framer Motion 10+ and lucide-react 0.280+ peer dependencies; its development setup uses TypeScript 5.5 and Framer Motion 11.
Versioned analysis explicitly targets Claude Desktop v2.37337.1 and reports REA v6.5.0. Earlier design notes and newer desktop observations should not be treated as one timeless specification.
The package exposes build/typecheck and a component preview; production-grade or high-fidelity wording remains the author’s assertion, without an independent comparison performed by this catalog.
UI component examples do not supply Claude model access, account services or a recovered complete desktop application. Native desktop effects require their own host integration.

MIT repository license. The asset policy documents system-font fallbacks and synthesized audio instead of bundled proprietary font/audio files; it does not grant rights in upstream Claude assets or branding.

name: Awesome REA/Decompiled Games
description_en: Groups game decompilations, source reconstructions, recompilations, native ports and demos by original game, with comparison rows linking related projects. It distinguishes launchers, engine work and creator-shared showcases from source-reconstruction efforts.
description_zh: 按原游戏整理反编译、源码重建、重编译、原生移植和演示，通过对照表链接相关项目，并区分启动器、引擎工作、作者分享的展示与源码重建成果。
requirements: The reviewed README has 103 game headings and 140 project rows across 8 categories. Some headings cover related editions and one repository can appear under multiple games; these are inventory counts, not independently verified completed projects.

The scope extends beyond REA-assisted work. Contribution rules require project-owned evidence before describing REA use; a screenshot, demo or collection listing alone is not proof of a recovered source tree.
Project type, runtime status, original-game requirements and licenses must be checked at the linked primary source. Creator-shared original browser games are a separate showcase category.

The two reviewed files do not establish a collection-wide reuse license. Images have source links, and new-image contributions require reuse terms or permission; this catalog does not copy those images.
An independent discovery collection; inclusion does not imply official REA affiliation.

name: Dinosaur runner: recovering one acceleration rule
description_en: REA’s documented teaching case inspects the HTTP t-rex-runner edition and reconstructs its speed-update rule. A separate controlled original-game check and a new demonstration compare update counts, including the floating-point step that crosses the nominal speed threshold.
description_zh: REA 的教学案例检查 HTTP 版 t-rex-runner，并重建其速度更新规则。单独进行的受控原游戏检查与新演示对比更新次数，包含浮点递增越过名义速度阈值的一步。
requirements: The recorded target is wayou’s HTTP browser edition at the cited revision, not chrome://dino/. Source and observation hashes identify that edition.

After read-only inspection, a separate Playwright controller disabled future scheduling and obstacles to call the original update function under controlled conditions; this was not passive REA behavior.
The reconstructed claim is limited to acceleration. Drawing, jumping, collisions and controls in the teaching game are newly authored, not independently recovered original gameplay.
Public result tables and code document the author’s checks; this catalog did not rerun them. The cited original-source excerpts retain Chromium attribution and BSD-3-Clause terms.

name: Windows Calculator: reconstructing percentage rules
description_en: REA’s case traces the installed Windows Calculator model DLL to explain different percentage behavior for multiplication/division and other operations. An analyst-selected function is interpreted against public Microsoft source and demonstrated with fixed browser examples.
description_zh: REA 案例追踪已安装 Windows Calculator 的模型 DLL，解释乘除运算与其他运算中不同的百分比行为。分析人员选定函数后，对照微软公开源码解释，并通过固定输入的浏览器示例演示。
requirements: The documented target is Calculator 11.2508.4.0 x64. The public source commit is an interpretation cross-check, not an identified build commit for that installed DLL.
Function selection was analyst-assisted; the illustrative agent conversation is not a recording of fully autonomous discovery. No PDB symbols were loaded.
Microsoft source tests were inspected, not run, and no completed Windows GUI input check is claimed. Browser checks exercise the explanatory examples only.
This reconstructs a bounded arithmetic rule, not the Calculator application. Public Microsoft source is MIT-licensed; access and rights to the installed target remain separate.

name: Feishu: an author-reported isolated second app instance
description_en: The author reports using Codex and REA analysis to adapt a separate macOS Feishu copy with its own application identity, data directory and single-instance lock. The account describes local signing and separation checks while retaining the original app unchanged.
description_zh: 作者报告借助 Codex 与 REA 分析，修改独立的 macOS 飞书副本，为其设置不同的应用身份、数据目录和单实例锁。文章描述本地签名与隔离检查，并称原应用保持不变。
requirements: The report targets Feishu 8.1.17 with REA 6.5.0 on the author’s Mac; reported elapsed times and isolation results were not independently reproduced.
The modified copy is locally signed and has automatic updates disabled. The article does not publish a redistributable replacement app or original-source reconstruction.
The author attributes some architecture tracing directly to Codex and cites prior feishu-clone work; the outcome should not be credited solely to REA.

Original hash/signature and process/data separation checks are author-reported. This case does not establish compatibility with later versions, vendor approval or rights to redistribute a patched application.

name: Snowball War: a bounded REA-assisted minigame reconstruction
description_en: The author uses REA’s Ghidra workflow to investigate the DOS Ski or Die binary, document Snowball War rules and rebuild that one minigame in Rust with SDL2. The public notes distinguish recovered tables and mechanics from approximations and deliberate presentation changes.
description_zh: 作者通过 REA 的 Ghidra 工作流调查 DOS 版 Ski or Die 二进制，记录 Snowball War 的规则，再用 Rust 与 SDL2 重建这一小游戏。公开笔记区分恢复的数据表和机制、近似实现以及有意调整的表现效果。
requirements: Requires the user’s matching DOS/EGA game files and Python 3 for asset extraction. The Linux build uses Rust stable (author-tested with 1.93), Cargo and SDL2 development libraries; Cargo.toml specifies the SDL2 binding 0.37.
The reported analysis used Ghidra 12.1.4 and JDK 21 through the REA CLI after unpacking EXEPACK. Caller-supplied function/code seeds are assertions, not independent discoveries by Ghidra.

Only Snowball War is reconstructed. Other events and the original engine are excluded; menus are new, and the close-up animation is deliberately restricted to the fort zone rather than reproducing every original placement.

The frame rate is approximated at 35 Hz, the original PRNG was not recovered, pause/exit keys are approximations, and audio playback is missing. Gameplay tests and static evidence do not replace the explicitly absent side-by-side comparison with the running DOS original.

The pinned LICENSE.md and Cargo.toml offer MIT OR Apache-2.0, while the README’s license sentence mentions MIT only. Original art/audio must be extracted separately; no game or test was run for this catalog.

name: Ledger Reborn: an independent accounting app informed by QuickBooks study
description_en: The maintainer reports using REA and Ghidra to study selected QuickBooks Desktop for Mac behavior, then independently implements a local accounting application. Its Python/SQLite engine persists double-entry journals, invoices, inventory and payments, while public synthetic fixtures test bounded accounting and rollback behavior.
description_zh: 维护者报告使用 REA 与 Ghidra 研究 QuickBooks Desktop for Mac 的选定行为，随后独立实现本地记账应用。Python／SQLite 引擎持久保存复式分录、发票、库存和付款；公开合成样例检查有限范围的记账与回滚行为。
requirements: The reviewed release is 2026.10.12-preview.1. The local browser edition needs Python 3.11+; the accounting core uses the standard library and SQLite. Native desktop builds use pywebview 6.2.1, PyInstaller 6.22.3 and Pillow 12.3.0, built on the target OS; Windows additionally needs the separately installed WebView2 runtime.

The maintainer identifies QuickBooks Desktop for Mac 2024 Trial, version 23.1.13.962 R14 Trial, as the investigation target. REA 6.4.0 with Ghidra, NIB decoding and selected runtime observations informed inventory arithmetic, budget signs, reconciliation paths and layouts. The Python/SQLite engine and frontend are independently written, not recovered Intuit source.

Public synthetic fixtures contain frozen, independently specified integer-cent expectations. Reviewed tests compare reports and check atomic rollback of invalid journals, bills and inventory operations. These are implementation checks, not a complete QuickBooks conformance suite; this collection did not execute them.

The separate original-software comparison reportedly matched three official-sample reports account-by-account to the cent. The vendor sample company and exports are not public here, so that result remains author-reported. It does not establish recovered invoice lines, SKU quantities, payment links or full company-file migration.

The preview is single-user, local and USD-only. Payroll, tax filing, live bank/payment services, multicurrency and complete QuickBooks migration are outside the implementation. Its cash-basis output is a defined management cash view, not established equivalence with all original or tax rules; full visual/interaction parity also remains unverified.

MIT covers the authored application; vendor inputs and bundled runtime dependencies keep separate terms. The preview is not Developer ID-signed or notarized on macOS and lacks Windows publisher signing. Package smoke tests and selected native-window observations have separate scopes; no installer, original application, vendor company data or runtime package was downloaded or executed for this review.

name: Pocket Tasks: reconstructing task state and persistence
description_en: A teaching case with disclosed prior source access carries a REA-assisted investigation of a small command-line app into a separate Node implementation. It preserves observed task editing, persistence and selection behavior, then compares scoped outputs against fixed expectations and captured reference sessions.
description_zh: 此教学案例明确披露作者先前接触过源码，将一次 REA 辅助的小型命令行应用调查推进为另行编写的 Node 实现。它保留所观察到的任务编辑、持久保存及选择行为，再将限定范围的输出与固定期望值及捕获的参考会话比较。
requirements: Pocket Tasks 1.0.0 is an authored local command-line app, not a commercial application or a native-binary benchmark. Its separate Node.js 20+ candidate implements nine commands and schema-1 JSON storage, including saved/draft separation, explicit save, cancel, restart and the original row-position selection quirk. It needs only the Node standard library and disposable local stores; there is no graphical interface or network backend.

The historical investigation combines REA JavaScript source analysis, ordinary source inspection and recorded process/file observations. The sanitized REA excerpt identifies the same target bytes but retains unknown semantic coverage and 230 semantic unknowns. It is not a canonical Evidence bundle or independent attestation, and parsing coverage is not behavioral equivalence. The later Node validator does not repeat that REA session.

The author had already seen the target source, reviewer scenarios, tests and prior answers before implementation. The candidate imports only Node filesystem/path modules; a published test definition copies its file alone before checking save behavior. Runtime independence from the reference does not establish independent discovery, a blind trial, clean-room provenance or an agent/model performance result.

The saved report records 16/16 checker process sessions across 12 scenarios and 10/10 replays of captured observations across seven scenarios. These overlap and must not be counted as 26 independent observations. The checker uses fixed, hand-authored expectations; responses and saved JSON are compared semantically, while malformed stores and foreign pending files use byte-preservation checks where required. The report retains humanReview=pending, reaTrial=unverified and independentEvaluation=false; these are author-reported results, not rerun by this collection.

The six recorded target/candidate/observation/validator/checker/packet-tool hashes and the oracle digest match the reviewed source. The report’s TASK.md packet hash instead matches an earlier instruction revision: a later edit changed review/authorization wording without changing the behavioral contract. Treat the packet record as historical evidence, not fresh validation of every file in the current package. The failure history also retains an initial restricted-Windows attempt with five passes and four failures, followed by nine passes with unchanged candidate code in a permitted local environment.

The contract bounds each invocation to 64 commands and 65,536 UTF-8 bytes, stores to 32 tasks and titles to 80 UTF-16 code units. Coverage is limited to named behaviors and tests; concurrent writers, crash durability, hostile filesystem races, UI behavior, hidden backends and production performance are outside the parity claim. MIT covers the authored example; upstream REA and other linked material remain separate. No target, candidate, checker, installer, model or upstream test was executed in this review.

name: Open Scrantic: reconstructing the Johnny Castaway screensaver engine
description_en: Reconstructs the Johnny Castaway screensaver engine in Rust, with author-disclosed REA and Claude Code use. It reads original files to run recovered animation scripts and calendar-based story state on modern desktops; documented deviations and limited tests stop short of complete behavioral equivalence.
description_zh: 以 Rust 重建 Johnny Castaway 屏幕保护程序引擎，作者明确披露使用 REA 与 Claude Code。它读取原始文件，在现代桌面上运行恢复的动画脚本及按日历推进的故事状态；文档保留实现差异与有限测试范围，未确立完整行为等价。
requirements: Reviewed at v0.3.0: this is a Windows 3.1 screensaver-engine reconstruction, not a game port. The author reports recovering formats and TTM/ADS script semantics from disassembly, with human-directed REA/Claude Code work and comparisons against the original. Those reports do not establish exhaustive parity or an independent agent-performance result.

Builds pin Rust 1.99.1; Cargo declares minimum Rust 1.99 and edition 2024. The project targets Windows, macOS and Linux using winit, softbuffer and rodio. Linux builds also require ALSA development headers and pkg-config.

Runtime requires separately obtained SCRANTIC.SCR, RESOURCE.MAP and RESOURCE.001 beside the executable. README sizes and SHA-256 values identify the expected original files; the loader instead checks known executable strings/layout, not whole-file hashes. Arbitrary original builds are unsupported. Options and story state use SCRANTIC.INI, saved on normal exit.

Deliberate differences include full-frame redraw, potentially one-pixel line/ellipse differences, bounded final-scene selection and a fixed two-second title display. Optional dedithering and softened audio default off. The original settings dialog and password feature are absent, as are unused animated-palette, 256-color and ADS-variable features.

The headless test runs 6,000 steps and requires three completed scenes, without original-frame comparison. Data-dependent tests silently return when OPEN_SCRANTIC_DATA is unset; other tests cover parsing and arithmetic. CI checks formatting, lint, three-platform builds and --version, not cargo test or original-data playback. Snapshot output supports inspection, not an automated original-output oracle.

MIT covers project source, not original executable content, art, scripts or sounds, which users must supply with appropriate authorization. The author describes independent, non-commercial interoperability without Sierra/Dynamix endorsement. This collection reviewed sources and test definitions; it did not reproduce the implementation or results.

name: Eleven
description_en: An agent-first desktop reverse-engineering app that opens Mach-O, ELF and PE binaries, Android packages and GPU kernels, and lets any Agent Client Protocol agent read code, rename functions, add notes and propose patches in a shared window. Native code is decompiled by Ghidra through a bundled REA build, with Rizin and jadx as alternative engines. It is a workbench around existing engines, not a new decompiler or a reconstruction case.
description_zh: 以智能体为核心的桌面逆向工程应用，可打开 Mach-O、ELF、PE 二进制、Android 安装包和 GPU 内核，让任何支持 Agent Client Protocol 的智能体在同一窗口中阅读代码、重命名函数、添加笔记并提出补丁。原生代码通过内置的 REA 构建交由 Ghidra 反编译，也可改用 Rizin 和 jadx。它是围绕现有引擎的工作台，并非新的反编译器或重建案例。
requirements: Reviewed version 0.1.9 (release dated 2026-10-16) targets macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon, Windows x64 and Linux x64. The documented macOS and Windows installers pipe a remote script into the shell; macOS builds are not notarized, so the installer clears the download quarantine. Users supply the apps, binaries or APKs they analyze.

Native analysis uses Ghidra 12.x with Java 21 through REA, or Rizin for faster opening; first-run setup downloads missing engines or reuses local copies, and Ghidra is not bundled. Android packages need jadx, with apktool optional for smali. Building from source needs Bun, Node 20+, Ghidra, a JDK and a REA 6.x checkout; the release workflow builds REA from the Zfinix/rea fork’s feat/set-code-type branch rather than an upstream release.

Agents connect over the Agent Client Protocol, including the README’s Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor and Copilot options; model access, cost and data handling follow the chosen agent. Agents receive Eleven’s own MCP server and an eleven-rea proxy that passes REA tools through but redirects REA’s name, comment, bookmark and code-type writes into Eleven’s project. Per-tool Allow/Ask/Never permissions and privacy prompts are settings; this collection did not audit what reaches an agent’s service.

Byte patches are written to a copy, agent patches arrive as suggestions, and project changes are logged with their author and can be undone. CI at the reviewed commit runs typechecks on Ubuntu and macOS; the Ghidra-backed test suite is a separate local script. This review read source and documentation without installing the app, running agents or analyzing a target.

Eleven is Apache-2.0; the bundled REA and Node.js keep their MIT and other licenses, and agent logos remain their owners’ trademarks. The tool grants no rights to analyze, patch or redistribute third-party software, and its outputs are agent-assisted analysis rather than verified source recovery.

name: Flutter build identification
description_en: Identifies a Flutter APK’s Dart snapshot hash, per-ABI library digests and engine build provenance, then inspects one ABI’s AOT snapshot sections, through REA’s pure-parsing CLI and MCP tools. The string-pool output is a bounded byte-pattern projection of package and SDK URIs, not deserialized Dart classes or recovered source.
description_zh: 通过 REA 的纯解析命令行与 MCP 工具，识别 Flutter APK 的 Dart 快照哈希、各 ABI 库摘要与引擎构建来源，再检查单个 ABI 的 AOT 快照段。字符串池输出是对 package 与 SDK URI 的有界字节模式投影，并非反序列化的 Dart 类或恢复的源码。
requirements: Reviewed on main as rea-agents 6.7.0, which declares Node ^22.19.0, ^24.11.0 or 26+. identify-flutter-build and inspect-dart-aot (MCP identify_flutter_build and inspect_dart_aot) parse a caller-supplied APK’s libapp.so and libflutter.so without an engine, external tool, execution or network lookup. Inputs are copied into an owned read-only snapshot, with documented bounds such as 2 GiB per APK and 256 MiB per library.

REA performs no hash-to-SDK lookup; mapping a snapshot hash to a Dart release needs an external dataset such as reFlutter’s. Complete structural coverage currently requires the FullAOT kind of the supported Dart 2.14 snapshot layout, and other kinds are kept with partial coverage. Typed class and function recovery needs an SDK-specific parser, and class-like tokens include incidental matches.

The documented verifier runs both tools through the compiled CLI and stdio MCP on the Flutter Gallery 2.9.2 release APK against a pinned expectations file: one agreeing snapshot hash on all three ABIs, engine labels and URI counts. A plain aapt2-built APK checks negative detection. The guide reports the Gallery workflow and 147 focused tests passing on macOS 14.8.9 x86-64 and Windows 11 x64 guests.

In merged PR #1582, an independent reviewer reports that hashes, ELF sections and package lists matched readelf/strings checks on three F-Droid apps, PocketDhamma, Flutter McSweepy and cone, on pre-merge heads, with a non-Flutter control not detected; the thread records fixes for gaps found. These checks cover build identity and structure, not app-logic reconstruction. REA declares MIT; analysed APKs keep their own licenses, and this collection did not run REA or any APK.

name: Static HarmonyOS package inventory
description_en: Inventories HarmonyOS HAP, HSP and App Pack files through REA’s hardened ZIP reader and projects an execution-free application graph: component paths, IDs and hashes, Stage/FA packaging hints, runtime-family hints and path-based native-bridge hypotheses. Every claim rests on path presence; manifests, Ark bytecode, resources and signatures are not decoded or verified.
description_zh: 通过 REA 加固的 ZIP 读取器清点 HarmonyOS 的 HAP、HSP 与 App Pack 文件，并投影出无需执行的应用图：组件路径、ID 与哈希、Stage／FA 打包模型提示、运行时类别提示，以及基于路径的原生桥接假设。所有结论仅基于路径存在；清单、Ark 字节码、资源和签名均未被解码或验证。
requirements: Reviewed on main as rea-agents 6.7.0, which declares Node ^22.19.0, ^24.11.0 or 26+. No HarmonyOS SDK, toolchain or engine is needed: inspect-artifact produces the inventory and project-harmony-application-graph (MCP project_harmony_application_graph) projects it, with CLI and MCP sharing one workflow. .hap, .hsp and ZIP-verified root .app inputs are recognized; .har shared libraries are deferred because the suffix also names HTTP Archive JSON.

Outputs are path-presence claims: Stage is inferred only from module.json and FA only from config.json, App Pack children are listed without recursive inventory, encrypted or unavailable entries make coverage partial, and N-API bridge entries are hypotheses. Manifest semantics, Ark bytecode contents and versions, resource resolution, signing verification and observed native boundaries stay listed as limitations, and inventories that cannot be authenticated fail closed.

The verification lane downloads a SHA-256-pinned harmony-next-pipeline 1.0.1 HAP from an MIT-licensed source repository into an ignored directory and checks inventory authenticity, projection determinism, Stage path hints, exact component sets, complete coverage and CLI/MCP parity. The fixture’s compiler/SDK versions and reproducible build are not established, the lane does not complete the pinned-toolchain acceptance in roadmap issue #1431, and missing META-INF entries do not establish signing status.

REA declares MIT. Analysed packages keep their own licenses, and the guide says the fixture’s bundled component licenses were not independently audited; the downloaded artifact is not redistributed. Merged PR #1447 introduced this increment. This collection did not run REA or any package.

name: MIPS ELF analysis through Ghidra
description_en: Documents REA’s Ghidra lane for MIPS ELF executables, relocatable objects and MIPS16 shared images, including a pinned 32-bit language for recordless legacy firmware executables that Ghidra would otherwise import as 64-bit. Admission is bounded by declared header and ABI-record facts, and verification compares source-owned fixtures with independent readelf output rather than executing or rehosting firmware.
description_zh: 说明 REA 通过 Ghidra 分析 MIPS ELF 可执行文件、可重定位目标文件与 MIPS16 共享镜像的流程，包括为缺少 ABI 记录的旧式固件可执行文件固定 32 位语言，以免 Ghidra 将其按 64 位导入。准入以文件头声明和 ABI 记录为界；验证将项目自有的测试样本与独立的 readelf 输出对照，而不执行或重新托管固件。
requirements: Needs a caller-installed Ghidra and compatible JDK on a supported Linux or macOS host; Windows Ghidra P0 does not admit MIPS, and Hopper/IDA gain no MIPS support. The lane does not execute MIPS code or rehost firmware. The standard profile admits ELF32 executables and relocatable objects declaring o32 and MIPS32r2; MIPS16 shared images have a separate bounded profile. ELF64, n32/n64, microMIPS, machine variants, FP64, NAN2008 and PSP PRX are refused.

Merged PR #1898, for issue #1620, admits recordless legacy ELF32 executables with EF_MIPS_ARCH_32 or 32R2, an unspecified ABI field and an inspected absence of ABI-flags records. It pins MIPS:<LE|BE>:32:default and checks the language Ghidra reports after import. o32 is recorded as an analysis assumption, not a declared fact, and floating-point ABI semantics stay unverified.

Optional real-provider lanes need caller-supplied Clang with MIPS targets, LLD, GNU readelf or MIPS cross-binutils, and Ghidra. They build source-owned fixtures in both byte orders without executing them, comparing instruction bytes, symbols, languages and relocations with independent readelf facts. The guide states that pseudocode presence and decoding agreement do not establish runtime, delay-slot or complete floating-point semantics.

The issue author reports gating a local patch on four real MIPS32 LE firmware ELFs whose function entries matched separate 32-bit Ghidra exports, and 400 of 5,250 functions lost on one image under auto-selection; those files are not public. A PR reviewer tested header-edited OpenWrt kernels and BusyBox builds with Capstone cross-checks and found no unedited public recordless file. No device model, firmware change or runtime behavior is established.

REA declares MIT. Ghidra, compilers, binutils and analysed firmware keep their own terms, and the firmware behind the author’s results is not supplied. This collection reviewed the issue, PR thread and pinned sources without running REA, Ghidra or any target.

name: PSP static ELF analysis through Ghidra
description_en: Documents REA’s bounded Ghidra profile for static PSP ELF executables, which leaves Allegrex instructions, PSP loading and calling conventions to a caller-installed ghidra-allegrex extension while reusing REA’s CLI, MCP, Evidence and snapshot workflows. It admits one PSPSDK header and ABI declaration on Linux x64 and verifies selected static facts on a self-built fixture, not commercial games or PRX modules.
description_zh: 说明 REA 针对静态 PSP ELF 可执行文件的受限 Ghidra 配置：Allegrex 指令、PSP 加载与调用约定交由使用者安装的 ghidra-allegrex 扩展处理，同时沿用 REA 的命令行、MCP、证据与快照流程。它仅在 Linux x64 上接受一种 PSPSDK 文件头与 ABI 声明，并在自行构建的测试样本上验证选定的静态事实，不涉及商业游戏或 PRX 模块。
requirements: The initial profile runs on a Linux x64 host and admits little-endian ELF32 executables with the PSPSDK declaration e_flags 0x10a23001 and an inspected version-0 ABI-flags record matching the documented single-float Allegrex declarations. PRX, relocatable or shared images, PBP/ISO/CSO containers, emulation and live overlays are out of scope; missing or different declarations are refused, and file names do not identify a target.

Install a compatible ghidra-allegrex extension inside the selected Ghidra distribution; REA never downloads, installs, rebuilds or vendors it, and fingerprints its files before launch. The published compatibility pairing is Ghidra 12.1.3, extension v21.4, PSPDEV v20261001 and JDK 21; other builds that pass the metadata check are not described as independently verified. Missing prerequisites return PSP_EXTENSION_UNAVAILABLE without fallback.

Verification uses the real MIPS verifier’s PSP mode with caller-supplied PSPDEV tools. A maintained fixture built from tests/conformance/psp is analysed without execution and checked against PSP GNU tool observations: known functions, a direct call, an immediate, BITREV, a global word, snapshot reopening and an A-B-A target switch. Merged PR #1599 reports a passing real-Ghidra run on an earlier contribution head and says the final head was not freshly revalidated by that run.

These are selected static facts, not behavioral equivalence, complete VFPU semantics or general compatibility with commercial PSP executables; the extension does not fully model VFPU prefix effects. No commercial game data is used or reconstructed, and issue #1330 remains open. REA declares MIT; ghidra-allegrex, Ghidra, PSPDEV and analysed executables keep their own terms. This collection ran nothing.

name: Touhou reconstructions: an agent-driven method across three games
description_en: An essay published on REA’s site, with pinned evidence notes, describes one author’s agent-driven reconstructions of TH08, TH095 and TH04. It dates milestones from public commits and progress ledgers, separates exact-comparison and playable-build oracles, and documents a TH08 check that missed wrong floating-literal data. Project results remain author-reported, and REA is credited with supplying analysis evidence, not the reconstructions themselves.
description_zh: REA 网站发表的一篇文章及其固定版本的证据说明，介绍一位作者以智能体驱动重建 TH08、TH095 与 TH04 的过程。文章依据公开提交与进度记录标注里程碑，区分精确比对与可游玩构建两类判定依据，并记录 TH08 一项检查漏查错误浮点字面量数据的问题。项目结果仍为作者报告；REA 的作用是为智能体提供分析证据，而非完成重建本身。
requirements: The evidence notes, checked on 10 October 2026, treat three separate projects: a continuation of GensokyoClub’s TH08 1.00d reconstruction, a TH095 1.02a reconstruction started from zero confirmed functions, and a PC-98 TH04 reconstruction crediting ReC98. Milestone intervals use public commit timestamps and measure recorded spacing, not compute time, effort or a controlled speedup.

Pinned ledgers report 1,106 of 1,107 TH08 functions accepted, 696 exact TH095 functions out of 697 confirmed, and 661 exact TH04 functions out of 663 reviewed candidates, each under its own definitions; the notes warn against cross-game rates or whole-executable completion percentages. TH08 Linux and Web ports, a playable TH095 Windows i386 build and four TH04 DOS products are recorded milestones. TH04 play results rest on the maintainer’s manual observations, and its 64-bit port is in development.

In TH08, an instruction-byte comparison accepted source using 0.0 where the original executable used 128.0, because it did not check the referenced literal data. TH08 PRs #11 and #13 added literal-data checks and corrected twelve more stale references among 1,548 audited. The website work reexamined history and metadata without rerunning the historical compiler or game.

The essay and notes supply no game files, compilers or builds; each project’s repository documents its own original-game and toolchain requirements, and game rights stay with their owners. GensokyoClub’s TH08 history keeps its attribution and license, and its public policy excluding AI-primary contributions is paraphrased rather than adopted. TH08 has a separate catalog record; this review did not separately review the TH095 or TH04 repositories or run any project.

REA is described as supplying analysis evidence to agents; the projects also used their own analysis bridges and tooling, and historical results are not relabeled as REA output. The author presents the method and its industrial analogy as an account and argument, not a measured agent-versus-human comparison or proof that it transfers to other fields.

name: TicTacToe-AI: a bounded REA-fork reconstruction of one game method
description_en: The author’s REA fork, posted as rea-engine and since renamed RE-Agent, decompiles the shipped .NET executable of the GPL-licensed TicTacToe-AI game, recompiles the recovered C# and resources, and repairs one decompiler error against the original IL. A differential probe runs original and rebuilt code on all 19,683 board assignments for one status method and compares six form renders. The report passes only that method; the whole game remains partial.
description_zh: 作者的 REA 分叉（发帖时名为 rea-engine，后更名为 RE-Agent）反编译 GPL 许可的 TicTacToe-AI 游戏所发布的 .NET 可执行文件，重新编译恢复出的 C# 与资源，并依据原始 IL 修复一处反编译错误。差分探针在一个状态判定方法的全部 19,683 种棋盘赋值上运行原版与重建代码，并比较六张窗体渲染图。报告只判定该方法通过，整个游戏仍属部分重建。
requirements: The reviewed develop commit (2026-10-15) reports Feature PASS for CheckGameStatus over its declared 3^9 board domain and PARTIAL for the whole game. AI move selection and RNG, menus, timing and sound are unverified, the executables are not byte-identical, and raw terminal captures differ by one carriage return. The posts’ “byte for byte” wording therefore applies to structured board records and six render PNGs, not to the program.

The input is the published TicTacToe-AI executable from tatlead’s GPL-3.0 repository, identified by SHA-256 in the report. The repository redistributes it with the GPL text and a source archive kept for license compliance; the statement that this source was not consulted during reconstruction is author-reported.

The fork needs Node.js 22.19+ or 24.11+; recovery uses ilspycmd plus a host Roslyn compiler and Mono references, with script defaults pointing at Homebrew paths on macOS. Verification needs a local X11 display and Mono/libgdiplus. The recorded run used macOS 15.3.1 on ARM64 with Xvfb, so both renders come from the same Mono runtime rather than native Windows.

Scripts recover a fresh replica, then a probe executes the original and rebuilt assemblies, compares return values and indicator bytes for every board, and captures Form.DrawToBitmap images after button sequences. The current result JSON records zero board-record mismatches and terminalBytesEqual false. This collection read the reports and scripts without running the executables, tools or probe.

The fork is MIT with morluto’s REA copyright retained and lists optional engines such as Ghidra and Frida under their own licenses; the game and its reconstruction carry GPL-3.0 obligations. Fork-specific code is not part of upstream REA releases, and the repository was renamed after the posts, whose rea-engine link now redirects to RE-Agent.

name: REA in Claude Code: an isolated static-analysis A/B trial
description_en: A Japanese field report connects REA 6.4.0 to Claude Code in a separate project directory, denies 43 of its 170 tools and common shell launch forms, and compares REA-enabled and REA-disabled runs on two real tasks: an Electron terminal’s packaged files and a saved HAR capture. Both arms answered correctly, while the REA arm took up to 2.00× the time and 1.67× the API-equivalent cost. It is an analysis-evaluation and safety-configuration case, not a reconstruction.
description_zh: 一篇日文实践报告在单独的项目目录中把 REA 6.4.0 接入 Claude Code，屏蔽其 170 个工具中的 43 个以及常见的命令行启动方式，并在两个真实任务上比较启用与禁用 REA 的运行：一个 Electron 终端的分发文件，以及一份保存的 HAR 通信记录。两组都给出正确答案，而启用 REA 的一组耗时最多为 2.00 倍、按 API 计价的费用最多为 1.67 倍。这是分析评估与安全配置案例，而非重建案例。
requirements: The article by keigoly was published on Zenn on 2026-10-14 (JST). It pins REA 6.4.0 from the rea-agents package and runs it with a checksum-verified official Node.js 24.21.0 placed inside the project, because the host’s Homebrew Node 25.8.1 is outside REA’s supported range. All trials used non-interactive claude -p with Claude Opus 5.5 and permission prompts bypassed; the Claude Code version is not stated.

Isolation is configuration, not a sandbox: REA is enabled only through a project-local .mcp.json, a generated deny list blocks 43 tools selected from effect metadata, and Bash prefix rules block common package-runner launches. The author states that deny rules are a fence rather than isolation, that other invocation forms bypass the prefix rules, and that prompt injection through analysis output was not tested.

The tasks were MIT-licensed Orca terminal v1.4.224 (128 MB of distributed Electron files) and a 2.5 MB HAR from an unnamed venue website; answers were checked against Orca’s public source and the HAR data. The author excluded DRM or license circumvention, online multiplayer games, business or customer data and malware from scope.

Each condition ran once (n=1), the REA arm was told to prefer REA tools, parallel processes make timings approximate, and only static JavaScript/web work with one model was tested; an interrupted run was excluded and repeated. One REA analysis result exceeded the 10 MB MCP response limit. Scripts and JSONL logs are excerpted rather than published, so this collection could not and did not rerun the trials.

The author reports that REA helped with extraction, such as asar unpacking and HAR element extraction, while grep and small scripts carried code reading in both arms. Nothing was reconstructed: the HAR task identified an existing request path. Native binaries and APKs are deferred to a planned second step; Orca, the venue site, REA and the model service keep their own terms.

name: NativeAOT metadata recovery with Ghidra
description_en: Recovers .NET 8 NativeAOT metadata from x64 PE executables during REA’s Ghidra analysis: MethodTable relationships, virtual slots and frozen strings from RTR 9.1 data, through a built-in read-only parser or an optional headless adapter that annotates the Ghidra database. Generated names, inferred prototypes and recovered native pseudocode stay separate from the unknown original C# names, fields and source.
description_zh: 在 REA 的 Ghidra 分析中，从 x64 PE 可执行文件恢复 .NET 8 NativeAOT 元数据：通过内置只读解析器或可选的无界面适配器（会为 Ghidra 数据库添加注释），从 RTR 9.1 数据中取得 MethodTable 关系、虚表槽位与冻结字符串。生成的名称、推断的原型和恢复的原生伪代码，与未知的原始 C# 名称、字段和源码明确区分。
requirements: Reviewed on main as rea-agents 6.7.0, which declares Node ^22.19.0, ^24.11.0 or 26+. Bring your own Ghidra and JDK; the guide’s Windows check used Ghidra 12.1.4 and JDK 21. The built-in parser handles x64 PE32+ with .NET 8 RTR 9.1 metadata and needs a unique RTR header and exactly one DEHYDRATED_DATA row; other RTR versions and PE architectures are reported as unsupported or partial. Ordinary PE/CLI or ReadyToRun assemblies belong to REA’s managed-code tools instead.

The optional adapter is built from a clean pinned checkout of Washi1337/ghidra-nativeaot with existing git, javac and jar; REA records the JAR’s SHA-256, copies it and rechecks the digest before loading, and JARs run inside Ghidra, so supply a trusted build. It annotates within an ephemeral Program transaction and never changes the original executable. It is unavailable on Windows Ghidra P0, where database tools do not see rehydrated bytes and slot targets come from the parser report.

Outputs include MethodTable addresses, base types, interfaces, virtual slots and frozen strings, within documented local limits such as 128 MiB of captured PE bytes and 4 MiB of report JSON; rows beyond the report budget are omitted with partial coverage. Type identification uses upstream heuristics and prototypes remain inferences. Pseudocode is recovered native logic, not original C# source, and original class/member names and custom field layouts stay unknown.

Verification uses benign source-built .NET 8.0.22 fixtures with independent compiler/linker-symbol and directory-byte oracles, plus stripped and negative inputs; fixtures are never executed, and building them needs .NET SDK 8.0.416 and platform NativeAOT tools. The real MCP lane runs only on Linux x64 with the adapter. Windows-host behavior was checked manually once on Windows 11 x64 without the JAR against the fixture oracle and linker map; no CI lane repeats that check.

REA declares MIT. The parser’s hydration semantics are adapted from Washi1337/ghidra-nativeaot (MIT, with its notice shipped under licenses/) and cross-checked against .NET’s MethodTable.h. Analysed executables keep their own licenses. Merged PR #748 introduced the integration and issue #744 records the request and its closure without claiming C# project reconstruction. This collection did not run REA, Ghidra or any fixture.

name: UltraSunnyMoon: a partial, REA-led Pokémon Ultra Sun reconstruction
description_en: The author uses a pinned REA build with Ghidra to analyze a user-supplied Pokémon Ultra Sun base executable, rebuild it byte for byte from split objects, and swap in two small compiled C runtime routines. Both replacements are behavior-tested but nonmatching and every other byte stays original; one recorded input movie drives the original and hybrid builds to the same bedroom movement in the Azahar emulator. Retail compiler identity, exact matching, module loading and broader gameplay remain open.
description_zh: 作者使用固定版本的 REA 与 Ghidra，分析使用者自备的《宝可梦 究极之日》基础版可执行文件，由拆分出的对象逐字节重建该文件，并替换进两个编译后的小型 C 运行时例程。两处替换均经行为测试但与原字节不一致，其余字节均保持原样；同一段录制输入在 Azahar 模拟器中让原版与混合构建到达相同的卧室移动场景。零售编译器识别、精确匹配、模块加载及更广泛的游戏行为仍待解决。
requirements: README reports that the original and combined rebuilt games reproduce controllable bedroom gameplay, that both C replacements are behavior-tested but nonmatching, and that no completion percentage is claimed. STATUS.md (updated 2026-10-12) lists an unchanged main executable and one CRO module rebuilt byte for byte, the integrated __aeabi_vec_ctor_nocookie_nodtor helper and a 36-byte startup BSS clearer. The hybrid builds still contain mostly original code and assets and need a 3DS runtime; a native PC port is a later phase.

Requires the user’s own Ultra Sun base version 0 container (title 00040000001b5000, product code CTR-P-A2AA) kept locally; the v1.2 update stays a separate comparison input. TARGET.md records the author’s base container SHA-256 3bb3b4eb0d17f18875d8b847c871dc97a172beeda03ce99e59e62a78ed5c1a53 and notes that these hashes identify the supplied dumps, not every copy. Retail containers, extracted code, raw REA dossiers, game frames and emulator logs stay in ignored private directories.

SETUP.md uses Ubuntu WSL on Windows with Node.js 22, Python 3, GCC and readelf. Its bootstrap builds REA from source revision 7ae3c50a9d49c480035855de9fcc4484befacd92 (package version 6.4.0) and runs it with Ghidra 12.1.4 and Temurin JDK 21, with Capstone 5.0.7 as an independent decoder. Rebuilds use a pinned 3DS Decomp Pipeline revision, the C replacements were compiled with Ubuntu’s gcc-arm-none-eabi (GCC 10.3.1), and runtime checks use Azahar 2126.2 and its RPC interface.

The project reports independent byte checks of the unchanged rebuilds, isolated behavior tests and live RPC readbacks for the replaced routines, and 60 passing source-owned tests. Runtime evidence is a bounded startup, setup and bedroom comparison under one input movie; routine execution counts, battles, overworld coverage, full-movie completion and timing determinism remain unverified. The tests use source-owned fixtures, not retail bytes; this collection ran neither the tools nor the game.

README directs agent-accessible analysis through REA and Ghidra and requires AI-assisted reconstructions to be reviewed against binary evidence; AGENTS.md and HANDOFF.md are written for continuing agent sessions, and RUNTIME.md records frame review by an independent reviewing agent. The repository has no license file and GitHub detects none; it describes itself as an independent fan project unaffiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak or The Pokémon Company. No runtime reproduction is claimed.

name: Reversed with AI
description_en: A moderated website directory of AI-assisted reverse-engineering projects across games, firmware, file formats, APIs and protocols, apps and legacy software. Each entry links to its primary source and records the author-reported model, tools, time, cost and outcome, with four checks for public source, reproduction steps, real-hardware testing and third-party confirmation.
description_zh: 经人工审核的网站目录，收录游戏、固件、文件格式、API 与协议、应用及旧软件领域的 AI 辅助逆向项目。每个条目链接一手来源，记录作者报告的模型、工具、耗时、费用与结果，并标注源码公开、复现步骤、真实硬件测试和第三方确认四项检查。
requirements: Reviewed as a live website on 2026-10-18, when the homepage reported 180 projects, 100 marked Works, 12 guides and 166 tools, and the sitemap listed 180 project pages. The site has no pinned revision or public source repository, so entries, counts and labels can change after this review.

Entries record target, model, tools, time, cost, outcome (Works, Partial or Research), a 1–5 human-effort scale and four reproducibility checks. The About page says figures are reported by authors, not measured by the site, and unknown fields are marked Not reported; a Works label is the author’s claim. A Reproducible badge needs Works plus public source and repro steps, with real-hardware or third-party confirmation for firmware and devices.

The policy lists interoperability, preservation, modding that does not bypass DRM or anti-cheat, legacy-software recovery, format, protocol and API documentation, the user’s own devices, CTFs and defensive malware analysis without live samples. It declines DRM, licence-check and anti-cheat bypasses, online cheats, leaked source, live malware samples and weaponised exploits. The site says it hosts no binaries or code and accepts takedown requests; each linked project still needs its own rights and original-asset review.

The maintainer, smyaseen (@whyamas on X), reviews every submission; sponsored placements are labelled, and the site says sponsors do not affect listings or order. Its guides include a third-party REA setup guide updated 2026-10-14, but the directory covers many tools beyond REA and is not an official REA resource. The reviewed pages show a copyright notice and no reuse license for directory content.

name: REA plugin for Hermes Agent
description_en: Nous Research’s Hermes Agent plugin package for REA. One catalog install registers REA’s MCP server, pinned to rea-agents 6.4.0 and launched through npx over stdio, with REA’s workflow skill adapted for Hermes and a separate crash-triage skill. About 170 REA tools stay behind Hermes’ on-demand tool search, and the adapted skill asks before tools that run programs, drive apps or change a connected Android device.
description_zh: Nous Research 在 Hermes Agent 官方插件库中发布的 REA 插件包。一次目录安装即可注册 REA 的 MCP 服务（固定为 rea-agents 6.4.0，经 npx 以 stdio 启动），并附带为 Hermes 改编的 REA 工作流技能和独立的崩溃分诊技能。约 170 个 REA 工具通过 Hermes 的按需工具检索提供；改编技能要求在运行程序、驱动应用或改动已连接 Android 设备的工具前先征得同意。
requirements: The reviewed pin is the hermes-official-plugins commit that Hermes’ plugin catalog installs; plugin.json declares version 0.1.0 under MIT. The catalog lists it as an official Nous Research plugin for Hermes 0.22.0 or newer, installed with hermes plugins install rea and hermes plugins enable rea. It is official for Hermes, not an integration published by REA. Node.js 22.19+, 24.11+ or 26+ with npx is required, not 23 or 25, and the first start downloads the pinned package. Also running rea-agents setup for Hermes writes a conflicting server entry that replaces the pinned one.

Static JavaScript/Electron/ASAR, package-inventory, Go/Rust metadata, PE-resource, .NET-metadata and HAR work needs nothing else. Core-dump and offline ELF-layout tools need a Python with pwntools 4.15.0, pyelftools 0.33 and Unicorn 2.1.2, named in Hermes’ .env file. Native decompilation needs a user-supplied Ghidra with a JDK, Hopper or IDA; Android code needs JADX and Java, and firmware or capture formats need Binwalk/Unblob, TShark, sigrok or WABT. Neither REA nor the plugin installs them.

Some REA tools run a command under a PTY, launch or drive an application window, change a connected Android device or overwrite a chosen file, and Hermes does not prompt before them. The adapted skill tells the agent to name the action and ask first, and to skip such calls in unattended runs. The README says REA sends no telemetry and reaches the network only for targets the user names; untrusted programs belong in an environment prepared for them.

The README reports a binary-first WinSCP 6.7 test on one Linux host: the console launcher imported in about 30 seconds, while the GUI executable took 663 seconds under a 1000-second Hermes budget that needs Hermes v0.23.0, and a later chat’s first query took 580 seconds. Both runs recovered 28,701 procedures without launching the Windows executable. These are author observations, not timing guarantees, and decompiler output is not reconstructed source. The plugin raises Ghidra’s startup deadline to 900 seconds; each call keeps Hermes’ default 300-second MCP deadline.

A 2026-10-15 commit removed a per-server timeout key that Hermes v0.22.2 rejected, so the package installs on that release; the per-server call budget waits for Hermes v0.23.0. The about-170-tool and roughly 460 KB schema figures describe REA 6.4.0 as stated in the README. The package and adapted skill are MIT, with REA’s MIT notice reproduced and the crash-triage workflow credited to crashlens (MIT); external engines and analysed targets keep their own terms. This collection reviewed source without installing Hermes, the plugin or REA.

name: crashlens
description_en: A crash-triage tool that turns Linux core dumps, runtime panics, exception traces and sanitizer reports into Markdown bug reports naming the crash type, the first frame in the user’s code and a stable signature. Its core-dump path calls the REA CLI to read the recorded crash and the binary layout, and can ask REA’s Ghidra provider for pseudocode of stripped functions; a Claude Code plugin bundles a skill and read-only MCP tools. It is a debugging integration around REA, not a reconstruction case, and its diagnostic accuracy remains author-reported.
description_zh: 崩溃分诊工具，将 Linux 核心转储、运行时 panic、异常堆栈和 sanitizer 报告整理为 Markdown 缺陷报告，指出崩溃类型、首个用户代码帧和稳定签名。核心转储分析通过 REA 命令行读取崩溃记录与二进制布局，并可调用 REA 的 Ghidra 引擎为无符号函数生成伪代码；附带的 Claude Code 插件包含技能与只读 MCP 工具。它是围绕 REA 的调试集成，不是重建案例，诊断准确性仍为作者报告。
requirements: The reviewed pin declares package version 0.1.0 and plugin version 0.2.0, and the README calls the project an early prototype. Text inputs, namely Go/Rust panics, Python, Java and Node.js traces and ASan/LSan/UBSan reports, need only Node.js 22.19+ or 24.11+. Core dumps need Linux x86-64, Python 3, the rea-agents package and a separate pwntools environment named by REA_PWNTOOLS_PYTHON; gdb, objdump and Ghidra 12.1.x with JDK 21 are optional. Windows minidumps and macOS crash reports remain roadmap items.

Users supply the core dump and the exact binary that crashed. The source calls rea inspect-recorded-crash and inspect-binary-layout, and rea decompile with the Ghidra provider for stripped functions; crashlens itself computes the load bias, compares GNU build IDs and warns on a mismatch. package.json declares rea-agents 6.4.0 or later as an optional peer dependency, and the author’s post describes compatibility with a pinned rea-agents 6.4.0; this collection did not check other REA versions.

The plugin bundles a skill and an MCP server. The README says three read-only tools but names four, and the server source defines analyze_failure, analyze_core_dump, decompile_function and analyze_crash_folder with read-only hints. A copy-paste prompt documents the same core-dump workflow for agents connected to REA’s own MCP server. Pseudocode is labeled as decompiler output, and crash types are heuristics with a stated confidence.

The project states that the analyzed program is never executed and that gdb opens the core with script auto-loading and debuginfod disabled. The optional --ai flag sends the Markdown report, including code snippets and log lines, to the Anthropic API; the local web app listens on 127.0.0.1 and requires a session token. Core dumps can hold secrets, and reports include local paths, log lines and register values.

CI runs typechecks and unit tests on Node 22 and 24, plus an end-to-end job that installs gdb, pwntools and the latest rea-agents and checks a report for a compiled NULL-dereference program. The README’s statement that agents using crashlens found the root cause in six of seven stripped-binary crash types is author-reported without published transcripts. This collection reviewed source and documentation without running the tool, REA or an agent.

The project declares MIT and uses REA, also MIT, through its public CLI; Ghidra, the Anthropic API and analyzed programs keep their own terms. The author’s posts propose a crash-triage skill beside the reverse-engineer-anything skill and offer a pull request to a Hermes plugin repository; the reviewed sources do not establish that it was submitted, merged or adopted.

name: Dinosaur runner: an REA-inspected speed rule rebuilt with Codex
description_en: The author uses REA’s MCP browser tools to passively capture the JavaScript loaded by wayou’s open-source T-Rex Runner page, then has Codex rebuild its acceleration rule in one self-contained HTML5 Canvas game. The report identifies the captured script by SHA-256 and separates verified source facts from reconstruction choices; only the speed rule is claimed, not full gameplay equivalence.
description_zh: 作者使用 REA 的 MCP 浏览器工具被动捕获 wayou 开源 T-Rex Runner 页面已加载的 JavaScript，再由 Codex 在一个自包含的 HTML5 Canvas 游戏中重建其加速规则。报告以 SHA-256 标识所捕获的脚本，并区分已核实的源码事实与重建选择；只主张速度规则一致，不主张完整玩法等价。
requirements: The target is wayou’s open-source, Chromium-derived T-Rex Runner page, not chrome://dino/ or hidden proprietary code; the investigation read JavaScript the browser had already loaded. Only the acceleration rule is reconstructed: start at 6 and add 0.001 per eligible update while below 13, with no elapsed-time factor. Artwork, physics, obstacles and scoring are new or simplified, and the intro, ducking, audio and narrow-screen speed reduction are omitted.

README and the report record REA MCP list_browser_targets and inspect_web_page calls over a local Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint, with no navigation, clicks or page evaluation; Codex handled analysis, implementation and tests. Evidence IDs and excerpts come from the author’s REA results, but the full evidence bundle is not published and the live upstream script may change.

Playing needs only a browser: dino-demo.html is self-contained, with no external assets, packages or build step, and a GitHub Pages copy is linked. The embedded tests run from the page’s Run speed tests button, the browser console or the documented Node.js harness with mocked DOM, Canvas and animation-frame interfaces.

The author reports 67 of 67 embedded tests passing (15 unit, 52 integration), ten rejected in-memory mutations and seven owner-reported manual browser checks on 2026-10-13 without browser or OS details. Floating-point results such as the extra step past 13 at update 7,001 were measured in the reconstruction, not sampled from the original. There is no CI or cross-browser coverage, and this collection ran nothing.

The project is MIT-licensed; short original-source excerpts keep the Chromium BSD-style header, and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md reproduces the upstream BSD-3-Clause terms. This third-party repository is separate from REA’s own dinosaur-speed teaching case.

name: Screen Studio: an author-reported REA study of auto-zoom rules
description_en: The author reports using REA to map Screen Studio’s Electron package, reading six auto-zoom and cursor rules from its obfuscated code with Claude Code’s help, and having Claude Code write an independent recorder and renderer from those rules. The article describes the commands, evidence, a cursor-alignment check and the clone’s gaps; neither the clone nor the decoded code is published.
description_zh: 作者报告借助 REA 梳理 Screen Studio 的 Electron 安装包，在 Claude Code 协助下从混淆代码中读出六条自动缩放与光标规则，再让 Claude Code 依据这些规则编写独立的录屏和渲染程序。文章介绍了所用命令、证据、光标对齐检查以及复刻版的不足；复刻版和解出的代码均未公开。
requirements: The 2026-10-13 article targets the macOS Screen Studio app’s app.asar with REA’s JavaScript application analyzer, run from the command line on the author’s Mac with a supported Node.js version and Xcode Command Line Tools; it names neither the REA nor the Screen Studio version. The author reports a 101-second run producing a 124 MB evidence file over 3,695 files, using an integrity policy that records, rather than stops on, 25 bundled native programs whose fingerprints no longer matched.

The relevant code was obfuscated. The author says REA’s source-recovery command was unavailable on macOS, so Claude Code wrote a separate script to make it readable; that step is the agent’s work, not REA output, and this entry records no method details. The decoded code is deliberately unpublished.

From the six rules, Claude Code reportedly wrote about 1,300 lines from scratch: a Swift ScreenCaptureKit recorder that logs cursor positions separately, and a Remotion renderer. The author reports 60 fps capture without dropped frames and a 22-second clip rendered in about 50 seconds on an M4 Pro, and says a redrawn cursor overlaid on a recording of the system cursor matched in most frames, with one fast-motion frame off by a few pixels.

The author lists gaps: no graphical editor, three cursor types, simplified motion blur, no typing zoom or click sounds, and camera and microphone code that has not been tested with a real camera; the clone is far from replacing Screen Studio. Its source is unpublished, so none of these results can be checked here.

The author says the clone uses no Screen Studio code or assets and advises reading a product’s user agreement first. This study of a commercial app establishes no vendor approval or redistribution right, and the reported rules may not hold for other versions.

name: Claude Code background lab: an REA-informed reimplementation of a desktop animation
description_en: Reimplements the glyph-wind background of the Claude desktop app’s Claude Code New session view as an offline WebGL2 page with a 38-slider control panel. The author reports a static REA investigation of the desktop shell and its remote web bundle, followed by a newly written renderer that reuses recovered timing and layout values. It shares the original’s visual vocabulary and interaction model but is not a pixel-identical extraction.
description_zh: 将 Claude 桌面应用中 Claude Code“新会话”界面的字符风场背景，重新实现为可离线运行的 WebGL2 页面，并附带 38 个滑块的控制面板。作者报告先用 REA 对桌面外壳及其远程网页包进行静态调查，再以新编写的渲染器复用恢复出的时序与布局参数。它与原效果的视觉语言和交互方式相近，但不是逐像素一致的提取。
requirements: The reviewed pin is the repository’s single public commit, dated 16 October 2026. PROVENANCE.md reports that the study targeted Claude desktop 2.37337.1, began with REA’s analyze_javascript_application, traced the shell’s remote page to the background module and stayed static: Claude was not launched or inspected at runtime. It records SHA-256 hashes of the retained ASAR and the decoded module and lists local REA evidence IDs whose archives are not published.

The public edition reuses recovered factual parameters, including 6.5 × 13 CSS-pixel cells, a nominal 9 px font, a 3 s entrance delay and fade-in, a 4 s wind reveal, a 500 ms focus fade-out and 42–64 px/s wind speeds. Its shaders, noise field, random generator, glyph sequences and single-pass instanced rendering are newly written. The author states that an earlier private prototype used extracted source and a bundled font, and does not claim a formal clean-room process.

Running it needs only a WebGL2 browser opening index.html, or a local static server where the browser restricts local files; there is no Canvas2D fallback, and system monospace fonts change glyph metrics. Development needs Python 3 and Node.js 18+, with no third-party runtime or build dependencies.

CI runs six Node tests of deterministic helpers, rebuilds the offline page, checks that it is current and runs a release check for offline output, syntax, local links and excluded extracted assets and local paths. VALIDATION.md reports manual Chrome-on-macOS checks of rendering and controls, but not a browser-verified settings import, runtime testing of Claude or a pixel comparison with the original. The reference recording’s remote build, seed, theme and font are unknown, and this collection did not run the page or tests.

MIT covers the original code and documentation. The repository states that it distributes no recovered Anthropic source, shaders, fonts, ASAR files, screenshots of the original, recordings or account data, and that its license grants no rights in Anthropic’s software, fonts or trademarks. It is unofficial and unaffiliated with Anthropic; REA is credited as the investigation tool rather than bundled, and the author also credits AI-assisted development.

name: DX-Ball: an REA-guided function-level reconstruction with Codex
description_en: The author has Codex use REA’s Ghidra tools to inspect the English DX-Ball 1.07 executable and recover it as typed C/C++, then compiles each function with the original-era Visual C++ 4.0 and compares it byte for byte with the original after mapping relocations. The same source also builds a MinGW Windows game and a portable core library. Exact reconstruction is still in progress; REA’s separate sound-pan showcase covers just one function.
description_zh: 作者让 Codex 通过 REA 的 Ghidra 工具检查英文版 DX-Ball 1.07 可执行文件并恢复为带类型的 C/C++，再用同时代的 Visual C++ 4.0 编译每个函数，在映射重定位后与原文件逐字节比较。同一套源码还可构建 MinGW Windows 游戏和可移植核心库。精确重建仍在进行中；REA 另行发布的声像展示只覆盖其中一个函数。
requirements: README marks exact reconstruction as in progress, to be followed by a playable Visual C++ 4.0 build and later platform ports. Generated PROGRESS.md counts 553 provisional function candidates, 475 with source, 395 byte-exact (85,106 exact code bytes) and 249 with scoped semantic acceptance, and says both Windows builds completed recorded original-board campaigns under Wine. A separate 50-board restored-CRT attempt on October 17 ended at its time limit without a full pass.

Supply the English v1.07 Windows archive identified in config/target.toml; the importer verifies the archive and DXBALL.EXE hashes and puts the executable and assets in the git-ignored original/ directory. README points to a third-party download site for that archive; the repository does not establish its distribution rights, and this catalog does not link it.

The documented host is Linux x86-64 with Git, Python 3.11+, Node.js 22.19.0, 32-bit Wine, Xvfb, CMake, Ninja and GCC or Clang, plus i686 MinGW for Windows cross-builds. Bootstrap scripts fetch a hash-pinned JDK, Ghidra and a Visual C++ 4.0 compiler from a third-party archive repository. The REA lock file pins rea-agents 6.5.0 with Ghidra 12.1.4, while docs/REA.md still names 6.4.0; the Codex goal workflow needs Codex 0.128.0 or newer.

An exact unit has zero differences across the whole function after COFF relocations are mapped to original functions, imports and data, with literal data also checked; match-units.toml records the inputs needed to replay each unit.
